info.description: Backend for NetriBeat. All signal processing runs on the backend. Upload Movesense JSON (ECG or RR) or CSV ECG files to /sessions. A `user` sees only their own data; an `admin` sees everything. See docs/api.md for the compatibility notes against the original api-spec.yaml.
